sourceOfTruth: assembled runtime IDs in src/ngnQuestionBank.ts plus source inventory and this ledger

runtimeInventory.verificationMethod: At run start, re-read src/questionBank.ts and src/ngnQuestionBank.ts: questionBank500 is asserted at 500 entries with 500 unique IDs; questionBank100 is asserted at 100 entries; questionBank600 = [...questionBank500V2, ...questionBank100] is asserted at 600 unique IDs. Cross-bank normalized prompt/scenario duplicate guards are present. The 364 authored rewrite records remain stable-ID replacements within the 500 core positions; curated JSON inputs are not additive.

baselineAudit.notes: Static triage only. 120/244 items in the third rewrite tranche are classified for substantive revision and qualified educator review; no clinical approval or content changes were recorded.

commonFindings: All 20 are single-response records using one normalized generic reassessment prompt; four option families and four corresponding rationale families are each reused five times.
All 20 scenarios lack sufficient topic-defining history, assessment, diagnostic data, medication/treatment timeline or focused clinical decision to support the named topic.

Multiple demographic/context mismatches occur, including newborns assigned renal calculi, dialysis fluid overload and myasthenic crisis, and a child assigned acute ischemic stroke or autonomic dysreflexia without the required context.

Unrelated high-risk findings repeatedly compete with the named topic: hyperkalemia with ECG changes, symptomatic hypoglycemia, severe hyponatremia with seizure, bleeding/coagulopathy, hypoxemia/hypercapnia and acute kidney injury/shock indicators.

The correct-response index matches the option-rationale correct marker, but generic options and rationales do not establish a clinically defensible answer for the stated condition; distractors are not topic-specific.

CJMM labels rotate evenly across four steps (five items each) but do not correspond to different item tasks. Blueprint metadata is limited to broad category/topic/difficulty/CJMM; specific objective, Client Needs subcategory and evidence references are absent.

The source helper marks every item generated, not clinically verified, draft, with an empty references array. Runtime migration upgrades the legacy interaction to contentVersion 3; this structural migration is not clinical validation.

No exact duplicate IDs were found in this 20-item batch; all 20 IDs are unique. Their prompts and answer/rationale patterns are near-duplicate templates. The existing 600-ID runtime uniqueness guard remains the assembled-bank protection.
